Independent exhaustively enumerated EVERY labelled subset per nondecreasing positive abundance partition for N=1..13, computed exact integer first and second species counts, checked partition counts p(1)..p(13), and found exactly (1,6,6) with strict maxima (3,6) at N=13; independent_rarefaction_audit_check.py in archive.
Source RESULT.md theorem/scope/indicator-covariance proof and full verify_rarefaction_peaks.py implementation
correctness.rationale: The actual theorem concerns any fixed positive-integer species abundance multiset with total N<=13 under uniform fixed-m without-replacement samples. For species presence indicators I_i, P(I_i=0)=C(N-a_i,m)/C(N,m) and P(I_i=I_j=0)=C(N-a_i-a_j,m)/C(N,m); expansion of Var(sum I_i) gives the stated source equation (1) with q_ij-q_iq_j. Nondecreasing positive integer partitions enumerate each species-label permutation class once; the partition recursion is exhaustive by induction on remaining total. Independently and without importing the source verifier, enumerated all 2^N subsets of the N labelled individuals for every partition of N=1..13, accumulated exact E[K_m],E[K_m^2], used rational arithmetic for every m, and tested BOTH strict inequalities at each possible m=2..N-1. Partition counts for N=3..13 were 3,5,7,11,15,22,30,42,56,77,101 (total 369), none below N=13 double peaked, and only (1,6,6) among the 101 profiles of N=13 gave >=2 strict local maxima at m=(3,6). Exact witness rational sequence matched all 13 source fractions; N=1,2 impossible by number of interior positions. Source verifier uses independent hypergeometric convolution checking every cell; its code and scope were inspected, but not blindly treated as a proof merely from its success statement. This is a complete finite sharp-cutoff proof, not an assertion about all larger N.
residual_risks: No infinite-family or N>13 classification; exhaustive finite enumeration is bounded by N<=13.
Independent subset enumeration constitutes a computational exhaustive proof with transparent finite domain, not a human/formal proof assistant certificate.

evidence: Nipperess–Matsen full article states moment identities on marked rooted/unrooted trees, explicitly including star trees whose rooted PD equals observed species richness, but supplies no all-partition N<=13 shape/cutoff theorem.

Tong PMID 6671130 abstract discusses majorization across communities with fixed same sample sizes and large-n asymptotic normality, which does not constrain local extrema in m within one fixed community.
Resultary published richness–Gini covariance and frequency-count covariance sign laws concern different statistics/models.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader variance formula subsumes calculation of each V_m but does not, as a stated theorem or immediate mathematical implication, yield the sharp minimum and uniqueness: these require proving exhaustive exclusions of 369 positive integer partitions through total 13. The older comparison/ordering theorems change abundance profiles at fixed m, not m at fixed profile. Residual possibility of a broader uninspected shape theorem is retained.

value.rationale: Finite rarefaction is an established mathematically meaningful model: the variance of observed richness versus sample depth is a natural uncertainty invariant for a fixed census. It need not have a single peak even though expected richness rises. Establishing the FIRST census where strict variance re-rise occurs and proving UNIQUE first-layer abundance multiset and both sample-depth peaks is a natural complete sharp finite classification, not a random unmotivated numeric slice or textbook substitution. The example (1,6,6) has one singleton and two equal abundant species, explaining competing early and intermediate sources of variance; m>=8 collapses to the singleton Bernoulli variance m(13-m)/169. This exact boundary can prevent an unjustified single-peak heuristic in rarefaction-depth uncertainty planning. No downstream theorem, asymptotic family, or claimed broad ecological application is needed for the bounded standalone result.
residual_risks: Only a sharp finite boundary, not a general classification of all abundance profiles or empirical species-sampling validation.
Its numerical cutoff is scientifically useful as a first counterexample boundary but not a universal sampling-planning rule.
